concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an art-directed visual concept for Jinsu Park's GitHub developer profile, NOT a generic SaaS site. Landscape art board 1536x1024. This is an exploratory composition, not a literal screenshot. Audience: engineers reading a candidate's actual projects. Show work, not grand claims. Readable typography, crisp visual hierarchy, sophisticated spatial layout. No Apple logo, no employer endorsement, no hiring promise, no invented metrics or scores, no 'AI engineer' mastery claim. Use only exact short text supplied. Four real projects and contributions: Sobi Tribunal, a whimsical navy/brown/gold spending-reflection web app featuring the pink pig judge in the references; user planned product, infrastructure, and coded all v1/v2 in a five-person team. SpeakUp, a light gray/dark plum speaking coach; user STT/LLM integration, coaching engine, replay, MP4 export in a three-person team, not all vision work. Vispresso, a charcoal/red/teal video review workbench with large source preview, editable ranges and timeline; user frontend in a four-person team. Thumbstap, solo Swift macOS tool, thumb double-tap on trackpad opens frosted full-screen 7-column app grid with search. Input reference 1 is actual pig judge, 2 courtroom art, 3 actual Thumbstap app icon, 4 actual Vispresso logo. Preserve those project identities, adapt scale and composition. Avoid identical cards, generic clouds/orbs/abstract gradients/coding robots, clip art waveforms alone, decorative dashboards, motivational slogans. Direction: 'Cutaway'. A precision exploded industrial model of software, studio photographed on cool #E7EAED light gray. Huge narrow black 'Jinsu Park' aligned at top left. Below, four richly detailed interface assemblies are distributed asymmetrically across a single long work surface, in shallow oblique perspective: pig courtroom connected to evidence panel and rules/LLM layer; speech transcript plus replay/MP4 panel; video preview floating directly over timeline/in-out controls; thin silver trackpad under frosted app grid. Fine engineering leader lines connect each to simple role captions. The implemented layers appear solid, other context as faint outlines. This is software section anatomy, NOT electronic circuits or hardware disassembly. Focus on actual interactive parts; realistic screen surfaces and fine shadows, only original project colors, balanced negative space. Text exactly: 'Jinsu Park', 'Inside the work', 'Sobi Tribunal', 'Product / Infrastructure / v1 + v2', 'SpeakUp', 'STT / LLM / Replay', 'Vispresso', 'Frontend / Timeline / Review', 'Thumbstap', 'Swift / Gesture / App grid', 'Code and project notes'. Small artistically controlled typography. No website chrome.

finalAssets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one final wide 1536x640 portfolio illustration for software engineer Jinsu Park. Visual series 'Cutaway': a precise exploded model of a REAL software interaction, lit like a premium industrial design prototype on solid cool light-gray #E7EAED studio surface. NOT a screenshot: an editorial cutaway showing actual software components as thin interface planes, strong clean oblique perspective, carefully controlled realistic shadows, crisp material edges and substantial visual detail. It should feel like unusual engineering exhibit photography, not generic AI wallpaper. Keep composition unified, use nearly full width with breathing room at boundaries, 2.4:1 landscape. No page title or captions; those are localized separately in HTML. No readable text at all except explicitly permitted short product identifiers. No invented metrics, scores, performance charts, awards, testimonials, tech logos, Apple logos, fake hardware circuitry or glass blobs. Use actual project-specific colors in the UI. No generic laptop mockup frames. All planes are software screens, not new product features. Subject: Sobi Tribunal, a spending-reflection web app. Reference 1 is the actual pig judge (pink pig, ivory judicial curls, black robe, gold trim, brown gavel); reference 2 is its actual navy/brown/gold courtroom. Preserve the distinct flat original pig artwork and court proportions on the main front-facing screen plane. Show the COMPLETE authored system: at left a dark-navy evidence-upload panel with camera glyph and receipt outline, at center the courtroom screen with large authentic pig judge and below it three answer buttons with no text, at right an ivory verdict-document plane and deep-red stamp shape; underneath an exposed logical rules plate with a small branch junction and a separate explanation text-line plate (deterministic verdict versus LLM wording). Connect the upload, interrogation and verdict planes into one compact physical assembly with fine routing lines, no arrows or circuit-board decoration. The two logic plates should look like diagram layers, not fabricated computing hardware. Don't create a generic finance dashboard or scales alone. Main contribution is planning, infrastructure, ALL v1/v2 coding, so the whole assembly has material weight. No textual pig nameplate or Hangul; remove lettering while preserving original pig art silhouette. Refined, playful subject with serious execution. Golden highlights, dark navy planes, pink pig, cool neutral backdrop.
